gloss: department head; head of a program

definitions.gloss: head of an academic department; program chair
definitions.explanation: The faculty member in charge of a {学科|がっか} — a degree program or department within a university faculty. Handles curriculum, staffing, and admissions for that program.

examples.japanese: {学科長|がっかちょう}に{相談|そうだん}した。
{来年度|らいねんど}から{田中先生|たなかせんせい}が{学科長|がっかちょう}を{務|つと}める。
examples.english: Professor Tanaka will serve as department head from next academic year.

examples.japanese: カリキュラムの{変更|へんこう}については、{学科長|がっかちょう}の{承認|しょうにん}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Changes to the curriculum require the approval of the department head.

notes:
Formed from {学科|がっか} (academic department, degree program) + {長|ちょう} (head of). The post is normally rotated among senior faculty for a fixed term rather than held permanently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学科長|がっかちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as department head
- {学科長|がっかちょう}の{承認|しょうにん}: the department head's approval
- {前|ぜん}{学科長|がっかちょう}: the previous department head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学部長|がくぶちょう}: dean — heads a whole faculty, one level above
- {学長|がくちょう}: university president — heads the entire institution
- {校長|こうちょう}: principal — of a primary or secondary school
